title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
slides: Microsoft thinks your next PC needs an AI chip.
You can run small AI models locally, no cloud.
But your current apps won't use that chip yet.
Upgrading now means paying for unused potential.
Wait six months or buy for battery life instead.
thread_text:
Microsoft's AI PC Bet

Every new Windows laptop will soon ship with a dedicated neural chip. Microsoft is betting you'll pay for it before any app actually uses it.

Local AI, No Cloud

Small models can now run entirely on your device. No internet, no subscription, no data leaving your machine.

The App Gap

Your current software can't see that chip. Developers need months to rewrite apps that tap into it.

Paying for Potential

You're buying hardware for features that don't exist yet. The silicon is ready. The ecosystem isn't.

Wait or Buy?

If you need battery life, buy now. If you want AI performance, wait six months. Check one app you use daily, does it list neural chip support?
